It was so chunky, it was barely spreadable. A real discontinued CFA item is the Chicken-Q. It was basically the dark meat of the chicken, mixed with CFA BBQ sauce that came shipped to us premixed in a bag that we reheated by putting the bag in boiling water, and kept the chicken-q warm in a soup double boiler. I remember selling maybe one sandwich every 4 months, and then it was really to only one customer. Another discontinued CFA item that I really loved was the carrot and raisin salad. Finely shredded carrots, raisins, canned pineapple (and the juice), sugar, mayo, and a touch of lemon juice. It was always better after the mixture sat for a day or two and the raisins basically rehydrated a bit.
